battle.name: 第一次敘利亞戰役
battle.theater: 北敘利亞奧龍特斯河谷與黎巴嫩山隘
battle.brief: 公元前一四五七年，圖特摩斯三世獨攝王權後第一次北上，與以卡迭施王為首、號稱九弓的敘利亞—迦南聯盟在奧龍特斯河谷與黎巴嫩山隘交鋒。埃及以弓兵與六輻輕車撕開聯軍陣線，持月牙劍的強臂步兵跟進收割殘敵。這是十七次敘利亞遠征的開端，詳細戰況僅存殘篇。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 第一次敘利亞戰役是埃及新王國第十八王朝與北敘利亞、迦南諸邦聯盟之間的第一次大規模較量，通常定於公元前一四五七年，是圖特摩斯三世獨攝王權之後向北用兵的第一役，也是後來十七次敘利亞遠征的開端。埃及一方以法老本人為全軍最高統帥，之下有丞相瓦希掌民政，王室設隨軍書記官逐日記錄行程；兵種分為以弓矢作戰的射手、以長矛與彎斧列陣的強臂步兵、乘六輻輕型戰車的車兵，每車一御者一射手，駕二匹馬，國王的近衛由謝爾登人等外籍傭兵持大盾充當，另有從努比亞與麥德雅抽調的民兵、海上盟友，以及數量龐大的搬運、供水與築壘人員。聯盟一方以卡迭施王為核心，聯結阿勒頗、圖尼普、哈西、努哈希什諸城與埃及在阿穆魯地區的附庸，骨幹是受沿海城邦與小亞細亞金屬供應的青銅裝備步兵，以及數量可觀的雙馬車兵，另有各城邦拼湊的雜色傭兵。在埃及的官方說法裡，這個聯盟被稱為九弓，卡納克浮雕把九位被縛之王刻在弓形的繩上，象征法老要拉斷的九把弓。
countriesEn: The First Syrian War was the first large-scale clash between the Eighteenth Dynasty of the Egyptian New Kingdom and the league of northern Syrian and Canaanite states, usually dated to 1457 BC. It was the first campaign to the north fought by Thutmose III after he took sole control of the state, and it opened the series of seventeen Syrian campaigns that followed. On the Egyptian side the pharaoh himself was the supreme commander of the whole army; below him the vizier Wah handled civil administration, and the royal household kept a military scribe who wrote down the day's movements. The troops fell into archers, the strong arm infantry who fought in line with spears and curved axes, and light chariot crews with six-spoked wheels, each chariot carrying a driver and an archer behind a pair of horses. The royal bodyguard was made up of foreign mercenaries such as the Sherden, who carried large shields, and there were detachments of Nubian and Medjay troops, allies who came by sea, and a very large number of men assigned to transport, water supply and the building of camps. The opposing coalition was centred on the king of Kadesh and drew together Aleppo, Tunip, Hasi and Nuhashi, together with the Egyptian dependencies in the Amurru district. Its backbone was bronze-armed infantry whose metal came from the coastal cities and from Asia Minor, together with a considerable force of two-horse chariots and miscellaneous hirelings gathered from several city states. In Egyptian official language this league was the Nine Bows: the reliefs at Karnak show nine bound kings on a bow-shaped rope, the nine bows the pharaoh meant to break.
people: 法老圖特摩斯三世（孟赫佩拉）是這場戰爭的核心人物。母親哈特謝普蘇特於他在位第二十一年第六月十日去世，阿爾曼特石碑記下她的卒日，他隨即獨自執掌王權，而在不到一年之間就把整個統治重心轉向黎凡特戰線，第一役正是他在位初年用來立威、並鞏固新王權的行動。軍中記錄戰況的是王室軍事書記官，卡納克阿蒙神廟的遠征名單殘存下各次遠征的次序與收穫，圖特摩斯三世在位第三十二年左右命工匠把戰功刻上編年史牆，奪車、俘虜與納貢的清單都出自那面牆。軍中老兵阿赫摩斯·彭內赫貝特在自傳裡回憶自己隨王北征、參與敘利亞諸役的經過，是少數留下自述的埃及軍人。敵方領袖方面，卡迭施王是聯軍的實際統帥，阿穆魯系的諸王是其中最積極的一批，卡迭施與阿勒頗諸王在往後數年裡一直是埃及北伐的對手，他們的名字沒有流傳下來，後世只能以卡迭施王稱之。埃及朝廷之中，丞相瓦希是國王處理庶政與後勤的主要依靠；宮廷畫師在雷赫米爾墓中畫下列特努首長進貢的場面，弓、矛與弓弦盒一併畫入，成為這段歷史留在埃及藝術裡最生動的一頁。
peopleEn: Pharaoh Thutmose III, Menkheperre, is the central figure of this war. His mother Hatshepsut died on the tenth day of the sixth month of the twenty-first year of his reign, a date recorded on the stela from Armant; he immediately took sole control of the state, and in less than a year he had shifted the whole weight of government towards the Levantine front. This first campaign was the action by which the new sole ruler asserted his authority and confirmed his new kingship. The man who wrote down what happened was the royal military scribe; the surviving campaign list of the temple of Amun at Karnak preserves the order and the yield of the expeditions, and around the thirty-second year of the reign Thutmose III had his exploits carved onto the Hall of Annals, including the lists of chariots taken, prisoners and tribute. The old soldier Ahmose Pennekhbet, in his autobiography, recalled serving in the northern campaigns and in the Syrian wars, and is one of the few Egyptians to leave an account of his own service. On the enemy side the king of Kadesh was the effective commander of the coalition, and the princes of the Amurru district were its most active members. The kings of Kadesh and Aleppo remained Egypt's adversaries for years afterwards, but their personal names were not preserved, and later generations could only call them the king of Kadesh. At the Egyptian court the vizier Wah was the king's chief support for civil government and logistics; a court painter in the tomb of Rekhmire showed the chiefs of Retjenu bringing tribute, with bows, spears and bow cases all painted into the scene, which is the most vivid page this history left behind in Egyptian art.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是埃及月牙劍（Khopesh）：外彎的單刃短劍，刃口向內彎成月牙形，砍進去不必回拔。在圖特摩斯三世的軍隊裡，它不是主兵器，而是步兵最後一段距離的貼身兵器。埃及重裝步兵的裝備是長矛、彎斧與圓盾，弓手用複合弓在遠程消耗敵陣；等聯軍陣線被箭雨與車兵衝散、缺口出現，揮月牙劍的強臂才湧上去割斷倒地者的頸項、鈎住敵盾邊緣、清理城牆缺口裡的殘兵。與它並列的是銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上的長矛、成束的箭、蒙皮木盾，以及法老近衛的謝爾登大盾。埃及的機動骨幹是六輻輕型戰車，兩匹馬拉一車，御者與射手同車，主要用途是追擊與亂敵陣腳。遠征的補給靠牛車、驢騾隊，以及由海路運來的糧食，貨船常停靠比布魯斯再沿陸路北上；攻城則用木製雲梯與臨時壘土。這一時期聯軍的裝備來源複雜，青銅斧與矛頭多由沿海城邦轉手，車兵多用雙馬輕車，數量多於埃及而整備較差。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Egyptian khopesh, a short single-edged sword whose blade curves inward in a sickle shape, so that a blow can be pulled back without reversing the cut. In the army of Thutmose III it was not a primary weapon but the close-fighting arm of the infantry for the last stretch of the business. The heavy Egyptian foot carried spears, curved axes and round shields, while archers wore down the enemy line at range with composite bows; only when the coalition line had been torn open by arrows and chariots, and a gap had appeared, did the khopesh-bearing strong arm surge forward to cut the throats of the fallen, hook the rim of an enemy shield and clear the survivors out of a breach. Alongside it were spears with copper or bronze heads bound to wooden shafts, bundled arrows, leather-covered wooden shields, and the large Sherden shields of the royal bodyguard. The mobility backbone of the Egyptian army was the light six-spoked chariot drawn by a pair of horses, with driver and archer aboard, used above all for pursuit and for breaking up enemy formations. Supply on campaign depended on ox carts, donkey and mule trains, and grain carried by sea to Byblos and then moved inland; siege work used wooden ladders and quickly thrown up earthworks. The coalition's equipment was of mixed origin, with bronze axes and spearheads passing through the coastal cities, and its two-horse light chariots numerous but less well kept up than the Egyptian ones.
tactics: 埃及的戰術骨架在第一役裡已成形。遠征隊伍以縱隊北上，由嚮導與偵察兵先探道路與水源，隊與隊之間留出拉開的距離，缺水處紮營時先派人取水並維持行列。作戰時埃及人習慣先以弓兵列陣，箭幕掩護車兵展開；戰車多部署在兩翼與前鋒，衝擊敵陣兩翼而不是硬碰正面。聯軍的密集車兵在平原上展開時，埃及車兵往往不與其正面纏鬥，而是以弓手射擊牽制，等聯軍車陣出現空隙再插入。步兵在後列成盾牆，逐步向前推進，縮短與敵人的距離；缺口一旦形成，揮月牙劍的強臂步兵湧入完成殘殺。對付聯軍的城塞，埃及人先圍而不急攻，在城下列營，把水源與糧道控制在自己手裡，等待敵方飢疲或援軍到達再決戰。整個過程高度依賴季節：雨季不宜用兵，遠征多在漲水期之後的乾燥月份展開，一場遠征往往拖到冬季才回師。
tacticsEn: The tactical framework of the Egyptian army was already in place at the first campaign. The marching column moved north in ordered ranks, with guides and scouts sent ahead to find roads and water, distances kept between one unit and the next, and water parties sent out first when the column encamped in a dry place. In battle the Egyptians habitually opened with the archers, covering the deployment of the chariots; the chariots were posted on the flanks and in front, striking the two wings of the enemy rather than charging the centre head on. When the coalition deployed its massed chariots on the plain, the Egyptian chariot crews generally refused to be drawn into a frontal struggle; archers kept up the pressure with shooting, and the Egyptian chariots waited until a gap opened in the enemy line before driving into it. The infantry advanced in a shield wall at the rear, steadily closing the distance; once a breach had been made, the strong arm with their khopeshes poured through to finish the work. Against the fortified cities of the coalition the Egyptians invested without rushing the assault, camping below the walls and keeping the water and the supply route in their own hands, waiting for the enemy to tire or for relief to arrive before deciding. Everything depended on the season: campaigning was impossible in the rains, expeditions were generally mounted in the dry months after the flood, and a single campaign often lasted until winter before the army marched home.
data: 這場戰爭留下的數字極少，可以確定的只有幾項。第一，阿蒙神廟的遠征名單把圖特摩斯三世在位頭二十年的北伐記成十七次，第一次敘利亞戰役是這串名單的開頭，通常定於公元前一四五七年，緊接其後便是翌年進入美吉多的那一次。第二，遠征隊伍自尼羅河三角洲與運河出發，經西奈半島北緣的通道進入迦南，再沿約旦河谷與沿海道路北上到奧龍特斯河谷，全程近一千公里，是可持續數月的行軍。第三，埃及方面的兵力沒有留下確數，但從同時代其他遠征的規模，以及隨軍搬運與供水人員的配比推想，總兵力當在數萬之眾，其中可作戰的射手、車兵與步兵是骨架，服務人員往往佔去相當比例。第四，聯軍車兵的規模在後來的記載中被形容為數百輛之眾，由多個城邦拼湊而來，裝備不齊。第五，遠征是按年推進的節奏：每年春天準備，四月前後出兵，入冬前返回，跨越數百公里的補給線是每次遠征最脆弱的一環。
dataEn: Very few numbers survive from this war, and only a few can be stated with confidence. First, the campaign list of the temple of Amun records the northern expeditions of the first twenty years of Thutmose III as seventeen in number; the First Syrian War opens that list, and is usually placed in 1457 BC, immediately followed by the campaign of the following year that entered Megiddo. Second, the column set out from the Nile delta and its canals, passed through the northern neck of Sinai into Canaan, and then ran north along the valley of the Jordan and the coastal road to the Orontes, a march of close to a thousand kilometres that lasted several months. Third, no exact figure survives for the Egyptian strength, but judging from the scale of other contemporary expeditions and from the ratio of transport and water parties to fighting men, the whole force must have been in the tens of thousands, with archers, chariots and infantry as its skeleton and the service personnel taking a substantial share. Fourth, the chariot strength of the coalition is described in later records as several hundred vehicles, gathered from several city states and unevenly equipped. Fifth, the expeditions ran to an annual rhythm: preparations in spring, departure around the fourth month, return before winter, and the supply line stretched over several hundred kilometres was the weakest part of every campaign.
cause: 打這場仗的根源有三層。最底層是埃及在黎凡特的權力真空：第十八王朝早期，尼羅河三角洲的權力中樞分裂，阿穆魯與迦南的附庸國彼此攻伐，北方的大國趁虛南下，卡迭施王在奧龍特斯河谷與阿穆魯地區建立了實力，敘利亞—迦南聯盟由此成形，埃及原有的宗主地位名存實亡。第二層是區域格局的變動：幼發拉底河中游的胡里人王國米坦尼與赫梯的影響同時伸進北敘利亞，這兩國的金屬與車兵供應讓聯盟的裝備水準明顯上升，與埃及較舊式的銅兵形成代差。第三層是法老本人的需要：圖特摩斯三世在母親死後匆忙接位，軍中對新王的服從還沒有確定，他必須用一場對外的大勝證明自己既是征服者，也是秩序的維護者。導火線則具體得多——聯盟在邊境要塞與商路沿途加固城防、攔截埃及通往比布魯斯的道路，第一役就是埃及要打通這條路而發動的。
causeEn: There were three layers behind this war. The deepest was a vacuum of Egyptian power in the Levant: in the early Eighteenth Dynasty the centre of power in the Nile delta was split, the dependencies in Amurru and Canaan fought among themselves, and the powers of the north pressed southward into the gap. The king of Kadesh built up a real position in the Orontes valley and in Amurru, the Syrian-Canaanite league took shape, and Egypt's old position as overlord existed in name only. The second layer was a change in the regional balance: the Hurrian kingdom of Mitanni in the middle Euphrates and the Hittites both reached into northern Syria, and the metal and chariot supply of those two states raised the standard of the coalition's equipment well above that of Egypt's older bronze formations. The third layer was the pharaoh's own need: Thutmose III had inherited the throne in haste after his mother's death, the army's obedience to the new king was not yet settled, and he had to prove by a great victory abroad that he was both conqueror and guarantor of order. The immediate trigger was far more concrete: the coalition was strengthening its frontier fortresses and blocking the road Egypt used to Byblos, and this first campaign was fought to open that road.
impact: 第一役的直接結果不是摧毀聯盟，而是把戰爭的主動權從聯盟手上轉到埃及手上：埃及軍隊第一次以常備遠征的形式深入黎巴嫩與奧龍特斯之間的走廊，把九弓聯盟從一個鬆散的邦國聯體，變成必須協同作戰的軍事集團。遠征制度本身也在這幾年裡定型：每年出兵、分季駐軍、沿途築壘取水、以戰車為機動骨幹、以弓兵為主力、以月牙劍等短兵器收尾，這套組合後來在十七次遠征中反覆使用，成為新王國後期對外戰爭的標準樣式。埃及軍隊也從徵召民兵為主的混合部隊，轉為以職業弓兵與強臂步兵為核心的常備軍，月牙劍這類短兵器正是在這一階段成為野戰部隊的標準配備。戰利品與各地進貢源源流入埃及，支撐起卡納克與孟菲斯的大規模營造；同時，連年遠征也把國庫與人力拉緊，宮廷內部對年年出兵的爭議從未停過。往更遠處看，埃及在北敘利亞重新站穩，直接把米坦尼推到前台，兩百多年後阿瑪爾納書信中那套對等的王朝外交，正是這條北線拉直之後的產物。
impactEn: The direct effect of the first campaign was not the destruction of the coalition but the transfer of the initiative to Egypt: for the first time the Egyptian army pushed deep, in the form of a standing expedition, into the corridor between Lebanon and the Orontes, and the Nine Bows league was turned from a loose association of city states into a military coalition that had to fight in concert. The expedition system itself was settled in these years: an army fielded every year, camps held through the season, earthworks thrown up on the march for water, chariots as the mobility backbone, archers as the mass of the army, and short weapons such as the khopesh to finish the work. That combination was used again and again through the seventeen campaigns and became the standard pattern of New Kingdom warfare. The Egyptian army also changed from a mixed force of conscript levies into a standing army built on professional archers and strong arm infantry, and it was at this stage that short weapons such as the khopesh became standard kit for field troops. Booty and tribute flowed steadily into Egypt and paid for the great building works at Karnak and Memphis; at the same time the yearly campaigns strained the treasury and the manpower of the country, and the argument at court over campaigning every single year never entirely died away. Further out, the re-establishment of Egypt in northern Syria pushed Mitanni to the front of the stage, and the parity of royal diplomacy seen in the Amarna letters two centuries later was the product of this straightened northern line.
result: 第一次敘利亞戰役以埃及的有限勝利收場：聯軍沒有被擊潰，卡迭施王與諸城邦仍在原位，但埃及軍隊已推進到北敘利亞，奪取邊境要點，把聯盟壓回奧龍特斯河谷與艾米吉多盆地一帶，並在本地留下守備與糧道，確立了遠征可以年年重複的樣子。戰役的勝負其實是在第二年才見分曉：翌年的美吉多之戰中，埃及在山口外設下堡壘，以弓兵與車兵分割聯軍，聯軍崩潰後美吉多被圍七個月才開城，那場戰役才真正把聯盟從主動進攻者降為守城者。但正因第一役已經把聯軍逐出黎巴嫩、把人馬集中在美吉多，翌年那場決定性的會戰才有發生的條件。對埃及而言，第一役的最大收穫在於證明了一件事：這支以月牙劍與長矛作最後手段的軍隊，能連續多年在離國千里之外作戰。
resultEn: The First Syrian War ended in a limited Egyptian victory. The coalition was not destroyed and the king of Kadesh and the city states were still in place, but the Egyptian army had advanced into northern Syria, taken the frontier strongholds, pressed the league back towards the Orontes valley and the plain of Megiddo, and left garrisons and a supply route behind it, establishing the pattern of a campaign that could be repeated year after year. The decisive turn came in the following year: at the battle of Megiddo the Egyptians built a fortified camp outside the pass, split the coalition with archers and chariots, and after the collapse of the enemy the city was besieged for seven months before it opened, and it was that battle which truly reduced the league from aggressor to garrison. But the first campaign was what pushed the coalition out of Lebanon and concentrated its forces at Megiddo, and so it was the necessary condition for the decisive engagement of the next year. For Egypt the real gain of the first campaign was the demonstration of one fact: an army whose last instruments were the khopesh and the spear could keep fighting year after year a thousand kilometres from its own borders.
